items.title: Allianz UK adds hotels and restaurants to Commercial Select policy
items.summary: According to Insurance Business, allianz UK has launched a hotels and restaurants proposition under its Commercial Select policy, offering sector-specific cover for businesses with a turnover between £10 million and £1.5 billion.
